instruction: Design the main screen (a single page) for an Enemy AI behavior demonstration. Include a top-down tactical arena with the player, several enemies, walls and obstacles, visible patrol or path lines, detection cones, attack ranges, and distinct AI-state labels such as PATROL, ALERT, CHASE, and ATTACK. Add a compact inspector panel with player health and AI legend. Put strong emphasis on making tracking, pathfinding, and state transitions visually understandable while maintaining a cohesive, polished tactical identity.
